_doc: MoT daily exploration pool (daily_v1, 21M) sampling config. Pairs with doc/mot/日常探索版筛选spec_v1_20260617.md. The 21M static pool ALREADY bakes in diversity (cluster gamma=0.6 + floor) and source flatten (alpha=0.7) at SELECTION time, so runtime cluster_beta/source_alpha are LIGHTENED here to avoid double-flatten. Caption=pointer (read at train time). No anime/TextAtlas in this pool -> domain_mix is real+synth only (present_renorm of the v3 mix, validated by rich_v1/e2e_dryrun.json). 8 loader rules from t5_sampling_weights_v1.json STILL apply.

stage_band_supply_warning._note: 2026-06-17 audit: daily_v1 1024 cannot assume T1/T2/T3/T4=18/27/15/40 without resampling. Training config must explicitly handle the 1024 stage before use.

1024.required_action: Do not use band_mix_real unchanged for 1024 unless allowing controlled replacement/resampling; otherwise choose a 1024-specific band mix or rebuild/supplement 1024 T1/T4 supply.

_source_alpha_note: LIGHTENED from母池 0.5: the static daily pool already flattened sources at selection (alpha=0.7 -> laion+coyo ~48%). 0.2 = light runtime touch-up only, avoid double-flatten. Set 0 to use the static pool as-is.
_cluster_beta_note: LIGHTENED from母池 0.5: static pool already cluster-flattened (gamma=0.6 + floor) at selection. 0.2 = light runtime; set 0 to use static pool as-is.
_aes_note: off; aes already used as a soft selection weight when building daily_v1.
_monet_real_gpic_ratio_complete_v1_note: SUPERSEDED for training by complete_v1: complete_v1 stage-256 real-internal split = MONET-real:GPIC = 11:7 = [0.611,0.389] (daily static pool 11M:7M natural ratio; Evan 2026-06-17), NOT 80:20. daily_v1 standalone is no longer the active line -- use configs/t5_sampling_complete_v1.json.

domain_mix._note: real+synth ONLY (this pool has no anime/TextAtlas). = present_renorm of the v3 cross-domain mix with anime/TextAtlas dropped and the rest renormalized (matches rich_v1/e2e_dryrun.json present_renorm). Loader must renorm defensively. monet_real:gpic split inside 256 = 80:20.

resolution_routing._note: Eligibility masks. Use the manifest's elig_256/elig_512/elig_1024 columns directly (precomputed from width/height). GPIC@512/1024 disabled via monet_real_gpic_ratio=[1,0].

band_to_captioner_priority._note: Identical to母池 t5_sampling_weights_v1.json. MONET: first captioner whose tok_* is in the drawn band; soft preference, fall back to any captioner with tok>0 in band. GPIC uses its i1 caption; synth uses its generation prompt.

daily_extra_columns._note: daily_v1 manifest adds these beyond the 33-col rich schema.
daily_extra_columns.wk: watermark prob (float; GPIC=NaN). Already hard-cut >source-p95 at selection (text-rich exempt).
daily_extra_columns.sscd_nn: nearest-neighbor SSCD cos (float; GPIC/synth=NaN). Already used as a soft uniqueness weight at selection.

loader_rules._note: Same 8 rules as configs/t5_sampling_weights_v1.json (holdout exclude, band eligibility by tok>0, tok<=0 unavailable, GPIC@512/1024=0, aes-missing, global stats, domain_mix renorm, image-source=.tar-not-thumbnail). daily_v1 real+synth holdout already 0; stage routing uses elig_* columns.
